source_text: Balac aedificat aras; Balaam vadit in occursum divinationis. Dominus ponit verbum in ore eius: non maledicere potest quos Deus non maledixit.
pass_a_gloss: Balak builds altars; Balaam goes into meeting of-divination. Lord places word in mouth his: not to-curse he-is-able whom God not cursed.
pass_b_english: [[Balak builds altars; Balaam goes to meet omens >> Bible:Numbers 23:1-6]]. The Lord puts a word in his mouth: he cannot curse whom God has not cursed.
